name_input: Bombay Tools Center Bombay Pvt Ltd
export_evidence: No export record with date/destination/HS/B-L was observed. The only readable shipment page (importkey.com/countries/india/bombay-tools-centre-bombay-private-limited) is an IMPORT dataset: "Total Shipments 3183 Records detected" / "Latest Cargo 2026-02-25", and every visible row runs China -> India, e.g. "2026-02-25 | SHANGHAI MAXOM COMPANY. | BOMBAY TOOLS CENTRE (BOMBAY) PRIVATE LIMITED | OPEN WRENCH 18mm(HAND TOOLS KIT) | Shanghai Pt, CHINA | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | 82041110 | 7741412". The page's 'Buyers' block lists counterparties such as "AL-ARFAJ ENGINEERING COMPANY W.L.L ... KUWAIT" and "Mushor Technology for Trading Compa ... Riyadh Office King Fahad Road", but these appear inside a mixed multi-company buyer list (rows also name PCI ANALYTICS, APIGLOBE HEALTHCARE, ABB INDIA, SULZER PUMPS etc.), so they cannot be attributed to this company as its own export shipments. No dated export B-L attributable to the company was seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split was retrieved. The only address-level fact seen is the registered address on the customs record: "41, NAGDEVI CROSS LANE, PO BOX 3029" (Mumbai). No domestic supply record observed.
note: Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey reported 3183 total shipment records for the legal name, but only 5 detail rows were rendered in the free view, and all 5 were imports of hand tools (HS 82032000 pliers, 82041110 open/ring wrenches) from Shanghai Maxom / Cangzhou Tianlong into Nhava Sheva — i.e. the company is evidenced as an IMPORTER/distributor of hand tools, not as an exporter. Declared HS 820411 is consistent with the observed import lines (82041110), so no HS correction is needed. Export status is 'unknown', not 'none_found', because the free view only exposes import-side data and export-side sources (volza, eximpedia, importgenius, trademo) all returned 403/JS-challenge; DuckDuckGo search was down (connection refused), so no export-specific query could be run. Nothing here is a rejection ground: the entity clearly exists and trades. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the accessible views, not estimated. Recommended next step: paid Volza/Eximpedia export-side lookup or a targeted search for 'Bombay Tools Centre' + Kuwait/Saudi buyer names to convert export_status from unknown to confirmed or none_found.
